I cannot endure your insults any longer.
我再也不能容忍你的侮辱。
I can't endure that noise a moment longer.
那吵闹声我一会儿也不能再忍受下去了。
容许，允许；容许有…的可能性：
Her poetry is such that it will not endure a superficial reading.
她的诗意味深长，不可粗读。
坚持；维持，不退让

继续(存在)，持续，持久：
These words will endure as long as people live who love freedom.

忍耐；忍受(痛苦等)：
Even in the darkest ages humanity has endured.
即使在最黑暗的年代人也能忍耐。
to endure to the bitter end

持久不衰，不朽：
His plays have endured for more than two centuries.
他的戏剧经历两个多世纪而不衰。
